text: The slot holds the head `discriminant + sentences` for `tinyclip-39m-16` (shrinkage 0.3, species_com, gamma 0.03), fitted on `images/alachua-pre2025 (licence rule by)`, with 5911 species rows, and a bias a row. Every photo's vector (`images/alachua-2025.wasm-int8-per-channel`) went through `tools/fusion/fuse.py`, the reference of the page's arithmetic, with the slot's own files as the page reads them (half-precision rows). Settings: rule `mix`, t_kind 0.5, w_kind 0.7, alpha_prior 0.5. On 1803 tuning photos (val) the thresholds came out as name_at 0.68 and offer_at never (no level reached nine in ten). On the 4197 test photos the kind of eye is right for 86.0% (84.9 to 87.1); the top species is right for 43.8% (42.3 to 45.4) and is among the first five for 66.0% (64.5 to 67.4). `person` was said for 0.02% of these photos and `none` for 0.14%; the set holds neither. The top species from fuse.py differs from a direct matrix computation on the same files for 0 photos. The kinds head is `kind rows fitted on the fitting photos and the extra set (a kind's photos weighted by the inverse square root of their number)`. With kind_at 0.54 (set on wildlife tuning photos and the extra set's tuning third), the page asserts a kind for 73.0% (71.7 to 74.4) of the wildlife test photos and is right for 96.7% (96.0 to 97.3) of those; for the 27.0% (25.6 to 28.3) where it is not sure, the true kind is among its three likeliest for 87.9% (86.0 to 89.7). On the 1240 test photos of people, cats, dogs, grazing animals and rooms (`images/coco-kinds.wasm-int8-per-channel`), the kind is right for 96.7% (95.7 to 97.7); the page asserts a kind for 92.7% (91.2 to 94.1) and is right for 99.0% (98.4 to 99.5) of those; where it is not sure the true kind is among its three likeliest for 95.6% (91.2 to 98.9). A species is named on 14.8% (12.9 to 16.9) of these photos. The slot needs: species.bias_url (build 7 of the page); kinds.bias (build 7 of the page); fusion.rule mix (build 7 of the page); fusion.kind_at (the build of the page that has the answer `not sure`).
